task.name: getephemtable
task.shortdescription: Query the JPL-Horizons database for ephemeris data and create a CASA table
task.description: This task retrieves the ephemeris data of a specific ephemeris object by sending a query to JPL's Horizons system and creates the ephemeris data stored in a CASA table format.

param.name: objectname
param.description:
Name of ephemeris object. The common name of major bodies such as planets will be converted into the (NAIF/SPK) ID. If the parameter, asis is set to True, no such check or conversion will be performed before sending a query to the database. Default: ''
Example: objectname='Titan' objectname='606'

param.name: asis
param.shortdescription: A toggle for objectnamne check to be done or not
param.description:
A toggle for objectname check to be done or not. asis=True will override any checks on objectname and the name has to be recognized by the JPL-Horzions system.
Default: False
Set asis=True to specify an ojbect such as a comet by a designated name

param.name: timerange
param.shortdescription: time range of ephemeris data to be queried
param.description:
Time range of ephemeris data to be queried. Default: ''
Standard CASA timerange specification('T0~T1'),YY/MM/DD/hh:mm, or by Modified Julian date or Julian date if the string is prefixed by 'MJD' or 'JD'.
Examples: timerange = '2023/09/01/20:45~2023/09/02/04:00' (Note: Both start and end times need to be fully specified starting with YYYY but hours or minutes can be omitted as long as the start and stop times are distinguishable. The omitted hours or minutes are translated as '00') timerange = 'MJD 60175.1~60176.1'

param.name: interval
param.shortdescription: Interval or step size of ephemeris data
param.description:
Interval or step size of ephemeris data Default: '1d'
A string with integer value and unit (minutes, hours, days) or a string with integer value without unit (= timerange/interval). The unit can be given as the first few characters, e.g. 'm', 'min', 'h', 'd'.
The JPL-Horizons query allows the step size by calendar months or years however the task will not convert such data to the CASA table as Measures requires the ephemeris table data in equal time interval. When the calendar months or years is specified for interval, the task execution will result in a SEVERE error. The raw query results will be saved even such a case if rawdatafile parameter is specified.
Example:
interval='1h' interval='15m'

param.name: outfile
param.description:
Output CASA table name Default: ''
Example: outfile = 'Titan_MJD60175.1-60176.1.tab'

param.name: rawdatafile
param.shortdescription: Name of raw ephemeris data file (optional)
param.description:
Name of raw ephemeris data file before converting into a CASA table (optional) Default: '' = No raw ephemeris data is saved
Example: rawdatafile='Titan-jplhorizons.dat'
